_about: Variant of the ALLOWED case. The baselined exception is still live -- its first site matches a real edge -- but a second site names 'synth_ghost', a target that is declared nowhere. The stale rule cannot see it: a subject that is absent from the evaluated graph is deliberately excused there, because a UI test in a headless build is absent without being dead. Expected: EXCEPTION-SITE-TARGET-MISSING.

synth_config._note: Qt6::Qml is allowed -- Qml is not Quick, and core runs profile scripts through QJSEngine. Qt6::Network is listed only because Qt6::Qml re-exports it.

synth_platform._note: Qt6::Gui PUBLIC is allowed for a platform adapter: a public header puts QKeySequence in its signature. Gui is not Widgets.

exceptions.reason: Two sites. The first is the live implementation-to-adapter edge. The second is a zombie left behind by a deleted target: it inflates the site count in the summary while matching nothing, which is exactly how a ledger comes to understate the debt it exists to track.
